title: Framer Website Design and Development | The Brandle
description: Framer website design from a Dubai studio that makes its own Framer templates. Custom sites with a CMS, fixed quote first, live in 3 to 6 weeks.

hub.name: Framer design
hub.line: Sharp sites for launches with a date attached.

hero.joke: We like Framer so much we make templates for it. Then we tell clients not to use templates.
hero.intro: Framer website design and development for startups, launches and anyone who needs a sharp site soon. Custom design, a CMS for the parts that change, and animation that feels native. Fixed quote, 3 to 6 weeks.

items.p: In Framer the design file is the site. Nothing gets lost in translation because there's no translation.
Page transitions, scroll effects and hover states made with Framer's own tools, so they stay smooth and stay editable.
Fewer moving parts means less time between yes and live. Handy when the launch date was picked before the website was.

items.t: A CMS for the changing bits
items.p: Blog posts, case studies, changelog, jobs. Add one without touching the layout.
Desktop, tablet and phone layouts each get designed. Not left to chance and auto-layout.
Contact forms, analytics, page titles, share images. The things nobody notices until they're missing.

fit.p: Framer is the quickest way we know to get a custom-looking site live. It's happiest with marketing sites and launch pages. It gets unhappy when asked to be a shop or a web app.
yes: A startup that needs a site before the funding news
Launching a product or a campaign page
After motion without paying for custom code
Happy to change text and images yourself
fit.no: you need hundreds of CMS pages with complex filtering, which suits [Webflow](/services/webflow-website-design/) better, or a store, which is [Shopify](/services/shopify-website-design/).

proof.label: Our own work
links: See the rest on the work page
proof.p: We make our own Framer templates: Fanfare, Limonaia, Bezier, Rotonda and Sunwise. They're the best evidence of what we do in Framer when left alone with it.

items.p: A free call, a page list and a fixed quote. Bring the launch date. We'll tell you honestly if it's possible.
Straight into Framer, on the real canvas, with your real words.
Animation, CMS, forms and the phone layout. This is the stage where it stops looking like a draft.
Domain connected, analytics on, and the project moved into your Framer account. Free fixes for 30 days.

price.p: Websites start at $1,299, about AED 4,800, and you can [price yours](/pricing/) item by item. A site takes 3 to 6 weeks, and a small Framer build sits at the short end. Framer's own site plan is separate and paid to Framer.

faq.q: Can I edit my Framer site myself?
faq.a: Yes. Text, images and CMS entries are simple to change, and we show you around at handover. If you can edit a slide deck, you can update a Framer site.
It's fine. Pages load quickly and you control titles, descriptions, headings and redirects. What decides rankings after that is the content, which no platform writes for you.

faq.q: Should I just buy a template?
faq.a: If the budget is tiny, yes, and we mean it. A good template beats a bad custom site. Come to us when the template starts fighting what you need to say. Our [startup website guide](/blog/how-to-build-a-startup-website/) covers the trade.
Framer for speed and smaller sites. Webflow for bigger content libraries and finer control. The full comparison is in [Framer vs Webflow](/blog/framer-vs-webflow/).
